Effects

S. 27(3F) declared unconstitutional* Seán McManus v The Minister for Justice and Equality, Ireland and the Attorney General, 4 June 2021, HCt
*On 04/06/2021, the High Court found in Seán McManus v The Minister for Justice and Equality, Ireland and the Attorney General that Section 27(3F) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1977 was not compatible with Article 34.1 of the Constitution.
